intended_object: A helper feature map used inside a proof: given a family f of linear isometries, it sends x to a vector in the channel space whose 0th channel is zero and whose (a+1)-th channel is x_a times projectionMatrixFeature f x. It is built to get a positive-definite kernel identity (rawLiftChannel_inner), which is later fed into euclideanChannelFeatureMap.
explanation: The docstring ("axis-weighted projection-matrix feature, preceded by a zero channel"), the ad hoc types (CertificateFibre, CertificateAmbient, ProjectionChannelSpace) and the way it is used all show that this is an auxiliary construction from the library's harmonic-analysis certificate argument. Its only role is to realise a particular inner-product kernel through the lemmas rawLiftChannel_inner and euclideanChannelFeatureMap. Neither the literature nor Mathlib has a standard object that it formalizes.
